records.title: an empty cart shows no cart badge
records.acText: WHILE the cart is empty, the header shall not display a cart badge — it is absent from the view tree, not showing `0`.

records.title: tapping a catalog card opens the detail screen of that product
records.acText: WHEN the shopper taps the catalog card for `Sauce Labs Backpack (red)`, the app shall open a product detail screen titled `Sauce Labs Backpack (red)`.

records.title: tapping increase quantity twice sets the quantity to 3
records.acText: WHEN the shopper taps the increase-quantity control twice on the detail screen, the quantity shall read `3`.

records.title: adding 3 units to the cart shows a cart badge of 3 @smoke
records.acText: WHEN the shopper taps Add to cart with the quantity at 3, the cart badge shall read `3`.
steps: Add the product to the cart

records.title: adding 3 units twice shows a cart badge of 6, accumulating instead of replacing
records.acText: WHEN the shopper taps Add to cart a second time with the quantity at 3, the cart badge shall read `6` — the cart accumulates instead of replacing.
steps: Add the product to the cart
Add the product to the cart

records.title: the cart lists one row for 6 units, with name, unit price and quantity @smoke
records.acText: WHEN the shopper opens the cart holding 6 units of `Sauce Labs Backpack (red)`, the cart shall list exactly one row for it, showing its name, its unit price `$ 29.99` and the quantity `6`.
steps: Add the product to the cart
Add the product to the cart

records.title: the cart totals read the number of items and the price for 6 units
records.acText: WHEN the shopper opens the cart holding 6 units of that product, the totals shall read `6 Items` and `$ 179.94`.
steps: Add the product to the cart
Add the product to the cart

records.title: a cart holding a product is titled "My Cart"
records.acText: WHILE the cart holds at least one product, the cart screen shall be titled `My Cart`.
steps: Add the product to the cart

records.title: a cart holding a product shows the Proceed To Checkout button
records.acText: WHILE the cart holds at least one product, the cart screen shall display a `Proceed To Checkout` button. Its presence only; the checkout flow is out of scope.
steps: Add the product to the cart

records.title: raising the quantity without tapping Add to cart puts nothing in the cart
records.acText: IF the shopper raises the quantity on the detail screen without tapping Add to cart, THEN the header shall still display no cart badge — raising the quantity adds nothing to the cart.

records.title: an empty cart shows the title "No Items"
records.acText: WHEN a shopper who has added nothing opens the cart, the cart shall display the title "No Items".

records.title: an empty cart shows the message that the cart is empty
records.acText: WHEN a shopper who has added nothing opens the cart, the cart shall display the message "Oh no! Your cart is empty. Fill it up with swag to complete your purchase."

records.title: an empty cart shows the Go Shopping button
records.acText: WHEN a shopper who has added nothing opens the cart, the cart shall display a "Go Shopping" button.

records.title: tapping Go Shopping on an empty cart returns to the catalog
records.acText: WHEN the shopper taps "Go Shopping" on the empty-cart view, the app shall return to the catalog screen.
steps: Go shopping from the empty cart

records.title: tapping Go Shopping on an empty cart shows the catalog heading "Products"
records.acText: WHEN the shopper taps "Go Shopping" on the empty-cart view, the catalog shall display the heading "Products".
steps: Go shopping from the empty cart
records.platformNote: the iOS catalog heading is an element named "title" with no readable text (measured 2026-09-28)

records.title: an empty cart does not show the "My Cart" title
records.acText: WHILE the cart is empty, the cart screen shall not display the "My Cart" title.

records.title: an empty cart does not show the totals
records.acText: WHILE the cart is empty, the cart screen shall not display the totals (item count and total price).

records.title: an empty cart does not show Proceed To Checkout
records.acText: WHILE the cart is empty, the cart screen shall not display "Proceed To Checkout".

records.title: removing the last product with Remove Item shows the empty cart, titled "No Items" @smoke
records.acText: WHEN the shopper removes the last product from the cart with "Remove Item", the cart shall display the empty-cart view, titled "No Items".
steps: Add the product to the cart
Remove the product from the cart
